name: programming_group_branches
description: The explicit branch span of a group that does not cover the whole company.
lifecycle: Replaced when the group's span changes; deleted with the group (cascade inside the module). While a row names a branch, archiving that branch is refused.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the group (tenant key).
Group whose span this row belongs to.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, group_id) REFERENCES programming_groups(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The group belongs to the same company; rows are deleted with it.
Each branch appears once in a group's span.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX programming_group_branches_branch_idx ON public.programming_group_branches USING btree (company_id, branch_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds groups whose span names a branch, for the branch archive guard.
